meta.name: linkedin-reply-handler
meta.description: Draft a reply to one LinkedIn comment from its URL, or sweep a whole thread from just the post URL and draft a reply to every comment worth answering, in one batch. Use for replying to a comment, following an author reply, or clearing all comments on a post. Resolves the correct parentComment (LinkedIn flattens threads to 2 levels), filters low-value comments before a sweep, and posts via Publora on approval. Not for top-level comments (use linkedin-comment-drafter).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LinkedIn 帖子下的评论批量起草回复,确认后直接发布。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在 LinkedIn 发帖后要逐条回复评论,又想省下手工时间。
copy.tagline_en: Draft replies to every LinkedIn comment on a post, then publish after your approval.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you post on LinkedIn and need to answer many comments without the manual grind.

howto.what: 给它一条 LinkedIn 评论链接，它会解析链接、读取线程上下文，起草 1~2 条回复（每条 150–300 字符）并附一条表情回应建议，展示审批卡片，你确认后才通过 Publora 发出。
howto.when: 当你贴出一条带 commentUrn 的 LinkedIn 评论链接并要求回复，或想跟进作者对你的回复时触发。不处理顶层评论（那种用 linkedin-comment-drafter）。

say.text: 回复这条评论：<粘贴带 commentUrn 的 LinkedIn 链接>
say.note: 会先出草稿和回应建议，等你确认再发

say.text: 作者回复我了，帮我接着把这个线程聊下去
say.note: 沿用该线程上下文起草回复

say.text: 这条线程已经超过 72 小时了，还值得回吗

howto.what_en: Give it a LinkedIn comment URL and it parses the link, reads the thread context, drafts 1–2 replies (150–300 chars each) plus a reaction suggestion, shows an approval card, and posts via Publora only after you approve.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you paste a LinkedIn comment URL containing commentUrn and ask to reply, or when you want to continue after an author replied to you. Not for top-level comments.

say_en.text: Reply to this comment: <paste the LinkedIn URL with commentUrn>
say_en.note: Drafts first; posts only after you approve

say_en.text: The author replied to me — help me continue the thread
This thread is over 72 hours old — still worth replying?
say_en.note: Original suggests a DM via linkedin-thread-monitor
